theorem signSensitiveReciprocalTotientDensity_error
    (rough : Finset ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) {lo hi V delta : ℝ}
    (hlo : V - delta ≤ lo) (hloV : lo ≤ V)
    (hVhi : V ≤ hi) (hhi : hi ≤ V + delta) :
    0 ≤ signSensitiveReciprocalTotientDensity rough c lo hi -
        V * reciprocalTotientDensity rough c ∧
      signSensitiveReciprocalTotientDensity rough c lo hi -
          V * reciprocalTotientDensity rough c ≤
        delta * reciprocalTotientDensity rough (fun d => |c d|) := by
  rw [signSensitiveReciprocalTotientDensity_sub_eq]
  constructor
  · apply Finset.sum_nonneg

/-- The density of this very same coefficient factors into the actual two
small-weight densities. This is an identity, not yet the sharp K bound. -/
theorem actualSmallRoughRho_density_eq
    (retainOdd : List ℕ → Bool) (N cap : ℕ) (w z L : ℝ) :
    physicalDensitySum (actualSmallRoughModuli retainOdd N cap w z)
        (actualSmallRoughRho retainOdd N cap w z L) =
      signSensitiveReciprocalTotientDensity
        (fixedRoughSupport retainOdd N cap w z)
        (fixedRoughCoefficient retainOdd N cap w z)
        (reciprocalTotientDensity (actualSmallRosserSupport N cap w)
          (actualSmallRosserMinus N cap w L))
        (reciprocalTotientDensity (actualSmallRosserSupport N cap w)
          (actualSmallRosserPlus N cap w L)) :=
  physicalDensitySum_smallRoughRho_eq_signSensitive
    (fun _ hd => actualSmallRosserSupport_smallPrimeSupportedAt N cap w hd)
    (fun _ hd => fixedRoughSupport_roughPrimeSupportedAt retainOdd N cap w z hd)
    (fixedRoughCoefficient retainOdd N cap w z)

whose pointwise polynomial is used in the physical majorant. -/
def actualSmallRosserMinusDensity (N cap : ℕ) (w L : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  reciprocalTotientDensity (actualSmallRosserSupport N cap w)
    (actualSmallRosserMinus N cap w L)

/-- The reciprocal-totient density of the same literal upper coefficient. -/
def actualSmallRosserPlusDensity (N cap : ℕ) (w L : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  reciprocalTotientDensity (actualSmallRosserSupport N cap w)
    (actualSmallRosserPlus N cap w L)

/-- The exact relative error from the proved fundamental lemma. Its first
term is small when epsilon is chosen small, but does not decay with D. -/
def actualSmallRosserDensityError (C K D epsilon : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  C * (Real.exp (-(1 / epsilon)) +
    Real.exp (Real.sqrt K - 1 / epsilon) *
      (epsilon * Real.log D) ^ (-(1 / 3 : ℝ)))

have hD1 : 1 < D := by linarith
  have hDpos : 0 < D := by linarith
  have hlogD : 0 < Real.log D := Real.log_pos hD1
  have hV := actualSmallEulerProduct_pos N cap (D ^ (epsilon ^ 2)) hN
  have hVbound := hEuler N cap hNpos hN (D ^ (epsilon ^ 2))
    (hDscalar D hDt).2 hcap
  rw [Real.log_rpow hDpos] at hVbound
  have hE : 0 ≤ actualSmallRosserDensityError C K D epsilon := by
    unfold actualSmallRosserDensityError
    positivity
  have hQ : 0 ≤ (r / epsilon ^ 2) *
      (1 + Krough / (epsilon ^ 2 * Real.log D)) := by
    have : 0 < Krough := by linarith
    positivity

theorem rpow_nonneg {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (y : ℝ) : 0 ≤ x ^ y := by
  rw [rpow_def_of_nonneg hx]; split_ifs <;>
    simp only [zero_le_one, le_refl, le_of_lt (exp_pos _)]
